judgments.reason: The CT finding of 'extension of inflammation into the apex' of the orbit, combined with right eye visual acuity limited to hand-motion detection and pain on ocular motion, directly supports orbital/ophthalmic involvement. The quoted span 'Bony erosion of the medial orbital apex bone, with extension of inflammation into the apex' appears literally in the vignette and clinically supports the ophthalmic anatomical modifier.
